decoded.meaning: SUBSCRIBER{ VALUE "/client" }: the target spelled as a VALUE string instead of a PATH TLV. A VALUE is never a path on the wire (05 §string form vs PATH-TLV form, erratum #1987), so this record names no target_path; written to :subscribers[] or :subscribers[N] it is refused tr::schema::type_mismatch (0x0030) and no edge is admitted
decoded.note: a well-formed TLV, so every codec round-trips it; the refusal is behavioural and is bound in core/tests/qos_policy_test.cpp (test_value_target_is_refused). The positive control is subscriber/policy-absent, which names the same /client as a PATH and is admitted
